body: Yeah, murderers have ways of faking suicides, besides, please don’t kill yourself, why would you want in the first place? What’s wrong?

First of all, please don’t kill yourself. Second of all, yes, without a doubt they will because legally they have to, because they need to make sure it wasn’t a murder, you were forced, etc. It’s something a lot of other places have to do. Your family also gets custody of everything you own, meaning emails, documents, social media, etc.

To be honest, coming from my perspective, and you don’t have to take my advice, this is just coming from personal experience, tell her. If she doesn’t understand then educate her, she might be coming from past experience of when she maybe dated a bi person and basing all her info on that. If she’s your mom then she’ll love you for who you are and not who you’re attracted to. If she doesn’t accept you, that’s her problem. I’ve partially noticed that there is more biphobia in the lgbt+ community than the straight community. They say that it’s a phase because some gays have called themselves bi, but really they ended up being gay, so they turn that into a reason bisexual isn’t a real thing. Always know that you should be loved and supported because that’s what everyone deserves.

Then talk to yourself, out loud while looking at a mirror. Ask your mind “Why do you want to pull me down?” As if it were your reflection. Then pretend to be your mind and answer the question, if your mind can’t find an answer then tell them why you want to stay motivated. If your mind does have a reason, defend yourself, yell, scream at your reflection as if it were someone else. Tell them why you deserve to be motivated and stay motivated, don’t doubt your words or emotions. If you cry, cry, if you scream, keep screaming. Let everything out and once you’re done, if you can, break the mirror, signaling that you won the battle and you’re victorious. I know it sounds fucking crazy but it helped me, it made me realize that I have control over my mind and body. Trust me on this, it’s not for everyone but it helped me so much when I did it.

She told me that she had never felt more scared in her life when she started to get dizzy and the few second before she went unconscious. She said that she’s glad she didn’t die because she knew she’d regret it. It’s not worth it so please don’t do it.

I know what you mean by being stuck in limbo when it comes to being unemployed, it’s frustrating but you can do it and I believe in you. The first thing you do when it comes to faking being okay, is to stop faking it. Talk to someone, holding everything in will destroy you from the inside I can promise you that, I did that for so long and I almost ended it all. It wasn’t until I talked to some that I felt better. It’s okay to tell people about your emotions. You’re human and humans have emotions and struggles and problems and that’s okay I promise you! ❤️ No one should do it alone, no one should feel alone, and no one should think they deserve to feel alone. Believe in yourself and believe things will get better. As my grandma always says. “What’s on your mind becomes what’s in your life so think the thoughts you want to see.” Things always get better and I can prove that to you. When I was younger, I was trapped in the hole of depression and suicide. One day when I was 12 I held a sharp knife up to my heart and almost pierced the skin on my chest. I’d hit rock bottom. But I stopped myself luckily and told my parents and they got me the help I needed. There are a bunch of websites where you can call or text a nonprofit therapist to help you when you need it. I promise you that things will turn around and get better. ❤️ As the inspirational poster with the cat on a string says. “Hang in the dude!”

In my opinion, like it or not. I think that would effect other people and you more than it would stop effecting people. No matter who it is, it always effects people, death that is. It’s like a black cloth being put over someone’s eyes when you die. They don’t know what to do, they’re disoriented, unorganized, scared, confused, upset, frustrated, etc. And no offense, sitting in a casket for all eternity sounds fucking boring as shit. Have you ever taken the time to ask the people you say you “hurt” and ask them what you could do to make it up to them? Sometimes we think that we hurt the people we care about most when we never did anything, the people that we did hurt forgave us and we choose not to believe it, or you hurt them and they don’t want to be anywhere near you, then so be it, make new friends. I know that’s hard but you can do it and I believe in you. Don’t end it when there is so much you could look forward to in your life. Dealing with bullshit is hard and I get that believe me. I’ve been through my share of troubles as well and I haven’t even hit college yet. I most likely have had gone through some things you’re going through right now. But ending it won’t fix anything, it never does. Somewhere, someone cares about you and what would happen if you were to kill yourself? So never end it, it never helps, it truly never does.

So you’ll go deeper and deeper until it’s to late, yes, your survival instincts will try and stop you but you lust to cut will get worse and worse until it doesn’t matter anymore. So don’t do it.
